description: For g>0, every finite sum of terms omega^e·n with e<g and natural coefficients n is below omega^g.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.OrdinalPowers.finite_sum_lt_power.{u} (g : Ordinal.{u}) (hg : 0 < g) (l : List (Ordinal.{u} × ℕ))
  (hl : ∀ p ∈ l, p.1 < g) : List.foldr (fun p r => Ordinal.omega0 ^ p.1 * ↑p.2 + r) 0 l < Ordinal.omega0 ^ g
